what.title: What OpenClawd Buddies is
what.body1: OpenClawd Buddies is a public, open-source registry. Every entry is a buddy pack — a tiny bundle of metadata and pixel art that OpenClawd knows how to display while you work. Think of it as a Pokédex for app companions.

body2.beforeCozy: The platform takes the guesswork out: there's a CLI for installing and submitting, a tagged gallery so finding the right companion doesn't require scrolling, and per-vibe collections like

pack.title: How a buddy pack works
pack.betweenFiles: defines the metadata — name, the 9 animation states, frame durations — and
pack.afterSpritesheet: holds the pixel art as a horizontal strip. OpenClawd loads them at startup and swaps states based on what's happening in your session.

whatIs.a: A OpenClawd buddy is a small animated pixel companion for the app. Each buddy ships as a single pet.json describing 9 states (idle, working, sleeping, etc.) plus a horizontal spritesheet. OpenClawd picks the right state automatically based on what you're doing in your session.

install.q: How do I install a pet?
install.a: From the gallery page or any buddy detail page, copy the install command (looks like `npx blockchain-buddies install boba`) and paste it into your terminal. The CLI fetches the buddy from R2, drops it under ~/.openclawd/buddies/<slug>/, and tells OpenClawd to use it. Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows (via PowerShell).

origin.q: Where do the buddies come from?
origin.a: Most buddies are submitted by the community through the website or the blockchain-buddies CLI. A handful are featured curated entries hand-picked from Crafter Station. Every buddy is reviewed by an admin before it goes live in the gallery.

submit.q: Can I submit my own pet?
submit.a: Yes. Sign in with the blockchain-buddies CLI (npx blockchain-buddies login) and run `npx blockchain-buddies submit ./my-pet/` — the CLI uploads the assets to R2 and queues the submission for review. You can also submit through the website at /submit. All you need is a pet.json file and a 9-state spritesheet.

openSource.q: Are OpenClawd Buddies buddies free and open source?
openSource.a: Every buddy on OpenClawd Buddies is free to install and use. Buddies keep credit to their original authors. The OpenClawd Buddies platform itself (CLI + site) is open source under the Crafter Station umbrella.

taxonomy.q: What's a vibe? What's a kind?
taxonomy.a: Each buddy is tagged with a kind (creature, object, character) and one to three vibes (cozy, playful, focused, mystical, …). These power the gallery filters and the per-vibe / per-kind landing pages so you can find a companion that matches your mood without scrolling 70+ entries.

money.q: How does OpenClawd Buddies make money?
money.a: It doesn't. OpenClawd Buddies is a community project run by Crafter Station. Storage and DB are absorbed by the platform team — no ads, no upsells, no telemetry beyond standard analytics on which buddies get installed.
